_doc: Harness settings with their defaults. Do not edit this file for one machine: put overrides in $AGENTGLIM_CONFIG, else $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/agentglim/harness.json, else ~/.config/agentglim/harness.json (same shape, any subset). app/settings.mjs merges defaults < user file < env. Paths: '~' is your home folder, '{plans}' the plans root (AGENTGLIM_PLANS), '{run}' the harness folder (AGENTGLIM_RUN, default {plans}/_run), '{agentglim}' this repo, '{data}' the app data folder (AGENTGLIM_DATA). Keys never go here: they go in .env (see .env.example).

lanes._doc: Free and local worker lanes. null = worker.sh's own value. free: the lane list in try order, each 'name=kind' (kind as agent.sh takes it, e.g. 'zen-1=zenrot', 'or=pi-or', 'local-qwen-1=pi-local'). freePauseS: seconds a lane sits out after a limit (worker.sh's own: 3600). worker.sh reads these only after the config patch is applied (docs/watcher-cutover-2026-11-06.md).

agentSh._doc: Model ids and usage gates for agent.sh. Names are agent.sh's own variables; null = agent.sh's own value. CODEX_MODEL_OVERRIDE (set by the Jev router) still wins over CODEX_MODEL. agent.sh reads these only after the config patch is applied.

status._doc: status-write.mjs, the Status card writer. appUrl: this dashboard. usageGate: a script that prints the Claude usage line (optional). featurePlan: a plan whose _build/subitems.json items (id >= featureMinId) show on the card (optional); featureLoop: a script run as 'SCRIPT status <plan>' for its loop line (optional). watchList: a file of plan folders always listed.

ioGuard._doc: io-guard.sh runs one heavy disk job at idle priority and pauses it while the disk is busier than pausePct, resuming below pausePct - resumeGap. Env IO_GUARD_DEV and IO_GUARD_PCT override per run.

localPilot._doc: On-demand local model server used by the local lanes. The supervisor starts it when a job needs it and stops it after idleStopS with no lease.

jev._doc: Jev model and effort router (harness/bin/jev-route.mjs). routes is the rules file; keyEnv names the env var holding the API key; log is the decision log the Routing page reads.

harness._doc: The Harness page inventory (a list of harness pieces). Missing file = the page shows settings and lanes only.

notify._doc: Desktop ping command, run as: command --event info --title TITLE BODY. Missing command = no ping.

skills._doc: Folders searched for the harness skills listed in manifest.json, first match wins.
